localizedValues.name: A1
localizedValues.description: Located at the south end of the Waterton townsite, this sunny, open campground has mowed lawns, few trees and is exposed to winds from Upper Waterton Lake. It is popular with campers who like to be close to the town's amenities and services.

localizedValues.name: A1
localizedValues.description: Situé à l'extrémité sud du village de Waterton, ce terrain de camping ensoleillé et ouvert avec pelouse tondue et quelques arbres est exposé aux vents du lac Waterton Supérieur.
